title: Group Indexes
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. Return a dict mapping each string to the list of indexes where it appears, in increasing index order.
hints: setdefault a list, or use defaultdict, and append the index.
Do not store only the last index.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Grouping indexes is the same shape as grouping values, with the payload being the index instead of the item.

editorial: Grouping indexes is the same shape as grouping values, with the payload being the index instead of the item. Appending preserves left-to-right order. Overwriting the list would keep only the last index and fail the repeated-key case.
